cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Can Handle This
cards.instruction: Perform complete emotional readiness while quietly borrowing coping strategies from every response around you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll read the rejection email aloud. I'm completely ready. What's the water for?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Small sips helped when I lost my job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Pour us both a glass; we'll take a sip before I start.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I had my sister read mine. I can read yours, if you want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what I meant by aloud. You read; I'll pour. Start with one sentence.

reason: Use a spoken role reversal caused by B4: A covers the change as the intended plan and offers pouring to retain help; the one-sentence request exposes the limits of performed readiness.
